name: writePNG
title: Write a bitmap image in PNG format

origin.description: Create a PNG image from an array or matrix.
origin.usage:
writePNG(image, target = raw(), dpi = NULL, asp = NULL,
         text = attr(image, "info")$text,
         metadata = attr(image, "info")$metadata)

arguments.name: image
arguments.text: Real matrix or array with values in 0 to 1, a nativeRaster, or a four-plane raw RGBA array.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: File name, binary connection, or raw vector. The default returns a raw vector.

arguments.name: dpi
arguments.text: Optional resolution in DPI, length 1 or 2. Mutually exclusive with asp.

arguments.name: asp
arguments.text: Optional aspect ratio x / y. Mutually exclusive with dpi.

arguments.name: text
arguments.text: Optional named character vector stored in PNG text chunks. R.metadata is reserved.

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.text: Optional R object serialized into the R.metadata text key.

origin.details: Planes are red, green, blue, alpha. Values outside 0 to 1 are clipped. Output is 8-bit deflate-compressed PNG.
origin.value: NULL for a file or connection, otherwise a raw vector of PNG bytes.
origin.example:
img <- readPNG(system.file("img","Rlogo.png",package="png"))
r <- writePNG(img)
img2 <- readPNG(r)
identical(img, img2)

translation.description: Write an array or native raster to PNG through libpng.
translation.usage: writePNG(image, target=None, dpi=None, asp=None, text=None, metadata=None)

arguments.name: image
arguments.text: NumPy array of reals in 0 to 1, a native raster, or a four-plane uint8 RGBA array.

arguments.name: target
arguments.text: Path, binary stream, or None to return bytes.

arguments.name: dpi
arguments.text: Optional resolution in DPI, length 1 or 2. Mutually exclusive with asp.

arguments.name: asp
arguments.text: Optional aspect ratio x / y. Mutually exclusive with dpi.

arguments.name: text
arguments.text: Optional named text chunks. R.metadata is reserved.

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.text: Optional object serialized into the R.metadata text key.

translation.details: Planes are red, green, blue, alpha. Values outside 0 to 1 are clipped. Output is 8-bit deflate-compressed PNG.
translation.value: None for a file or stream, otherwise bytes.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from png.readPNG import readPNG
from png.writePNG import writePNG
img = readPNG("Rlogo.png")
img2 = readPNG(writePNG(img))
print(np.array_equal(img, img2))
